component.name: Doors
component.summary: Run Windows games on Linux using Proton

description.p: Doors is a fast, minimal GTK4 / Libadwaita Windows (.exe) game installer and runner for Linux powered by Valve's Proton compatibility tools.

ul.li: Double-click any Windows (.exe or .msi) game installer to launch a clean install wizard.
Smart game detection for standalone executables, setup installers, and portable game directories.
Automatic extraction of high-resolution application icons and embedded metadata directly from Windows executables.
Native desktop menu (.desktop) shortcut creation with dedicated isolated Proton prefixes.
Built-in Proton runner manager and UMU database integration for automatic game fixes.
Support for multiple storage disks with free space indicators.
Comprehensive prefix & game settings: Wayland, HDR, discrete GPU offload, MangoHud, GameMode, Gamescope, NTSYNC/FSYNC, Winetricks, and winecfg.

screenshot.caption: One-click Windows game installer wizard with automatic UMU fixes.
Per-game Proton, display, and performance settings.

description.p: Release 0.3.0 with embedded PE metadata detection, UMU game fixes integration, built-in Proton manager, and improved setup installer tracking.
Release 0.2.0 with improved compatibility tool discovery, disk filtering, and AppStream metadata.
